question:
The following bar graph shows the number of patients visiting a hospital on different days of a certain week.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8be48b93b69f722058b6a6a8e6c1eeadb9fa66b8b9c9f578c91fac554adc813.png] 

Calculate the ratio of the total number of patients visiting the hospital on Monday or Wednesday to the number of patients visiting the hospital on Friday. [Note: None of the patients visited the hospital on more than one day during the given week.]
solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph showing the number of patients visiting a hospital on different days of a certain week is given.

**Formula used:**

Ratio of x and y = (x)/(y)

**Calculation:**

The total number of patients visiting the hospital on Monday or Wednesday = 145 + 138 = 283

The number of patients visiting the hospital on Friday = 179

Ratio = (283)/(179)

**∴ The ratio of the total number of patients visiting the hospital on Monday or Wednesday to the number of patients visiting the hospital on Friday is 283 ∶ 179.**

4a
